coverage: Later direct corrections remain after repeated scans, line movement and more than 20 superseding versions.
Replacement intents bind full normalized per-record revisions while unrelated keys can change.
Competing/unanchored/stale observations retain rejected receipts; independent accepted keys can commit with explicit incomplete status.
Byte/key/4096-receipt capacity limits, malformed markers/ledger, original retention failure, read-only policy, cancellation and source-revision conflicts fail visibly.
Native promotion rejects a mutated plan whose intent differs from captured source bytes.
Changed/deleted supporting markers invalidate FTS/fallback, structured/API/native query, salience and every context mode; unrelated source edits preserve stable intent.
Original source/revision/span bytes remain retrievable after edits/deletion; generated/code/history text is excluded; plain-to-machine conversion preserves notes.
Actual SIGKILL immediately before/after replacement leaves facts and receipts together; restart does not replay an old fact over a later correction.
Real temporary-daemon HTTP incomplete response preserves report, committed independent fact and rejected intent.

synthetic_regression_evidence.description: The original local fixture on the prior consolidation path failed because an old marker replaced a later correction. The final fixture suite is expanded; this is not evidence of a production race.

production_hold: Read-only host inspection: daemon/gateway inactive and disabled; dedicated PostgreSQL exited with restart=no. Existing 4B profile untouched; no 9B substitution.
remaining_limits: Linux synthetic host qualification, not production, MCU, Windows runtime, storage power-loss or retrieval-quality qualification.
Privileged out-of-protocol filesystem replacement is outside cooperating-writer guarantees; references identify content, not truth or indefinite retention.
Retained-source retirement/deletion policy, persistent cache erasure, generic recap/conclusion invalidation at every consumer, consumed-receipt compaction and bounded forgetting remain open.
Correction/invalidation never authorizes replaying an external effect. General executable requirement validators and effect-preserving handoffs remain subsequent work.
No paid scorer/model calls; owner-capped SAG2/TypeSafe canary and screening remain behind authority gates.
